mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines relative to its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0% for 2 months), or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails in more than 55% of joint decline cases (HOUST and RSAFS both declining), or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for three consecutive months signals manufacturing supply chain disruption, increasing input costs and reducing corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails in more than 55% of INDPRO < 100 for 3 months periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening consumer confidence and residential investment, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating price pressures that may trigger Fed tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails in more than 55% of joint PAYEMS decline/UNRATE rise cases, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle regime (GDP growth > 2.5% and unemployment < 4.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate margins and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails in more than 55% of INDPRO declines during late-cycle regime (GDPC1 > 2.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%), or Rank IC for regime-specific signal falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
